status: INTERNAL PREPARATION ONLY — NO INDEPENDENT REVIEW PERFORMED
purpose: Define the evidence, independence, reproducibility and disposition requirements that a future qualified reviewer must satisfy before independent_review may close for WS-BOEING-01.
reviewer_independence_requirements: reviewer is not the author/operator of the evaluated Worldshepherd implementation
financial, employment, subcontract, authorship and other material conflicts are disclosed
reviewer can issue an adverse, qualified or null conclusion without approval from Worldshepherd
reviewer receives immutable/digest-bound evidence inputs rather than curated screenshots alone
reviewer identity, qualifications, organization and review date are retained
reviewer scope and limitations are written before review begins
minimum_review_package: software bill of materials or dependency manifest appropriate to the reviewed implementation
input data provenance, authorization and dataset digests
baseline and intervention definitions if partner effects are evaluated
raw or partner-authorized ground truth sufficient to reproduce reported metrics
CI/workflow definitions and retained evidence artifacts
analysis scripts/notebooks or equivalent executable method
known limitations, adverse results and null results
security/data-handling scope relevant to the reviewed data
partner-supplied requirement/acceptance authority for any partner-specific conclusion

review_tests.test: Reproduce synthetic quality, APQP/PPAP, program-risk and change-propagation results from frozen source and fixtures.
review_tests.required_output: independent hashes, result comparison and discrepancy log

review_tests.test: Reproduce public manufacturing-analog results from source URLs/dataset digests without using retained metric outputs as inputs.
review_tests.required_output: dataset digest match, independently generated confusion metrics and discrepancies

review_tests.test: Audit train/test separation, missing-data handling, class-imbalance reporting and metric selection for leakage or favorable-metric substitution.
Verify external Boeing/Spirit partner claims only against partner-authorized evidence and applicable authority/requirements.
review_tests.required_output: claim-by-claim evidence matrix with unsupported claims rejected

review_tests.test: Verify contact-gate calculation, hard caps and required external states from raw gate inputs.
Review security/data-boundary applicability and confirm no controlled-information authorization is inferred from public-source preparation.

closure_requirements: all material discrepancies resolved or explicitly retained as qualifications
review disposition is signed/attributed and date-stamped
review report and evidence digests are retained
claims are bounded to the exact reviewed scope
no unresolved FAIL or REJECT_UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM disposition is represented as a closed validation gate
automatic_nonclosure_conditions: review performed only by Worldshepherd author/operator
review based only on synthetic/public analog evidence for a Boeing/Spirit production-effect claim
missing partner authorization for partner-specific data
unresolved data leakage or ground-truth ambiguity
reviewer cannot issue an adverse conclusion independently
review scope is narrower than the claim being made
contact_gate_effect: NONE. Preparing this protocol does not satisfy independent_review. That gate remains missing until a qualified independent reviewer actually completes and retains the required review against the relevant evidence.
claims_boundary: This protocol is not an independent review and does not establish independent replication, Boeing/Spirit validation, production effectiveness, security/compliance approval, certification, adoption, savings, defect reduction, or remediation probability.
